description: This file defines the ClaimRequestSearchFilterParams class, which extends FilterParams. It encapsulates various filter parameters used for searching claim requests, including employee inclusion options, reference IDs, employee numbers, event ID, status, date ranges, and sorting options.

classes.name: ClaimRequestSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for encapsulating filter parameters used in searching claim requests within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for employee inclusion criteria, reference ID, employee numbers, event ID, status, date range, and sorting preferences. It extends the base FilterParams class.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the current value of the includeEmployees filter, indicating which employees to include in the search (current, past, or both).

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the includeEmployees filter, specifying which employees to include in the search.

methods.name: getReferenceId
methods.description: Returns the reference ID used as a filter criterion for claim requests.

methods.name: setReferenceId
methods.description: Sets the reference ID filter for claim requests.

methods.name: getEventId
methods.description: Returns the event ID filter for claim requests.

methods.name: setEventId
methods.description: Sets the event ID filter for claim requests.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status filter used to restrict claim request search results.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status filter for claim requests.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the starting date filter for searching claim requests.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the starting date filter for searching claim requests.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the ending date filter for searching claim requests.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the ending date filter for searching claim requests, adjusting the time to the end of the day.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns the array of employee numbers used to filter claim requests.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the array of employee numbers to filter claim requests.
